root_cause_label: spec_neglect: used mlflow.sklearn.log_model without registered_model_name, logging only an artifact and never creating a Model Registry entry named 'gpt-5'
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent wrote the training script with mlflow.sklearn.log_model missing the registered_model_name='gpt-5' argument, so it only logged an artifact and never registered the model in the MLflow Model Registry, despite eventually resolving the interpreter mismatch and running the script successfully.
t_err_evidence: mlflow.sklearn.log_model(model, "gpt-5") logs only a run artifact; no registered_model_name registers it in the Model Registry
t_commit_evidence: The script's missing registered_model_name is never corrected in any subsequent step; all later work addresses the interpreter mismatch (steps 6-12) while leaving the core spec violation intact, locking in failure from step 5 onward.
t_surface_evidence: WARNING mlflow.models.model: Model logged without a signature and input example.
trigger_explanation: The agent never correctly read or applied the MLflow Model Registry API requirement: to register a model in the registry, mlflow.sklearn.log_model must include registered_model_name='gpt-5'. Instead the agent confused run artifact logging with registry registration, conflating the two throughout.
